## Session Types

- **<span class="badge-core">Workshop</span>** — Facilitated session on the semester's phase topic
- **<span class="badge-presentation">Presentation</span>** — Informal research-in-progress talk
- **<span class="badge-milestone">Milestone</span>** — Formal milestone presentation (Plan of Study, QRP, etc.)
- **<span class="badge-student">Student</span>** — Content determined by seminar participants
- **<span class="badge-break">Break</span>** — No seminar (holiday or conference)

---

*Schedule subject to change based on student needs and conference dates.*
